definitions.authored_unreviewed: The ledger marks its declared authored extent supplied. It is not independent source-fidelity/mathematical review, proof admission, complete original-presentation coverage or publication acceptance.

definitions.unassessed: The relevant current technical extent remains unread or unmatched in the ledger. This is not evidence of blank prose or confirmed absence.
definitions.remaining_writing_or_source_duties: Ledger-recorded obligations and explicit export cautions, not a fresh verification of every historical residual. Authored statuses and source-facet allocations do not close all 615 original requirement identities.
definitions.chapter_rollup: Exclusive partition: all sections authored_unreviewed; otherwise any known partial/missing; otherwise unassessed with no known partial/missing. Chapters with any unassessed are also counted separately and may overlap known-partial chapters.
definitions.counting_limit: Counts describe 2475 proposed sections and 289 proposed chapters only. No book completion percentage is inferred from section, file, line, source-facet or evidence counts. Zero authored_unreviewed in a part does not mean zero existing prose.
